pages.text: Pressing ESC opens a riveted board with three panels.

pages.title: Adventure (left)
pages.text: $(#b9a98a)Button - Opens - Key$()$(br)$(bold)Map$() - Xaero's world map - M$(br)$(bold)Quests$() - The quest book - -$(br)$(bold)Missions$() - This week's Brassworks missions - H$(br)$(bold)Waypoints$() - Your Xaero waypoints - U$(br)$(bold)Capes$() - Your $(l:lemursaucepacket:capes)cape$(/l) collection: every cape, how to earn it, and where to get another if you lose one - $(#e0ac46)/capes$()$(br2)Between the buttons: your coordinates, the time and the biome you're in.

pages.title: Game menu (middle)
pages.text: Every normal pause-menu button: Back to Game, Settings, Mods, Advancements, Statistics, Player Reporting, Give Feedback, Report Bugs, Disconnect. Buttons other mods add appear in the free slots or in the small tray under Disconnect.$(br2)Bottom right: $(bold)HUD Layout$() (see below).

pages.title: HUD Layout
pages.text: Moves and resizes the parts of your screen that other mods draw. The game stays visible behind a light shade, with a brass box over each part:$(br2)$(li)the minimap$(br)$(li)Jade (the block and mob info at the top)$(br)$(li)the voice chat icon and the voice group heads$(br)$(li)Create's goggle info$(br)$(li)Project MMO's XP gains and skill list$(br)$(li)pinned quests$(br)$(li)status effects and boss bars

Drag a box to move it. Boxes snap to the screen edges and centre lines; hold Shift to place one freely. Arrow keys nudge the box you clicked. Right-click a box, or click it and press $(bold)Reset$(), to put it back where its mod puts it; $(bold)Reset all$() does every box. $(bold)Save$() applies the new layout at once, $(bold)Cancel$() (or Esc) leaves everything as it was.

To resize a box, drag its corner handle, roll the mouse wheel over it, or click it and press $(bold)+$() or $(bold)-$(): from half its mod's size to two and a half times it, in 5% steps (Jade to twice). Its tooltip shows the size. The minimap keeps its own size setting (Xaero's UI scale, in its settings).$(br2)Pinned quests can only sit at an edge or a corner, so that box jumps to the nearest one when you let go. A box marked "(off)" belongs to something that's switched off in its mod; you can still move it.

The editor hides the live HUD and shows sample content inside each part while you place it. Drag to move, press $(bold)H$() or use $(bold)Show/Hide$() to stage visibility, then $(bold)Save$(). $(bold)Cancel$() discards both kinds of changes. Positions and visibility are saved in each mod's own settings, so your layout stays through pack updates. Also: $(#e0ac46)/hudlayout$(), or bind $(bold)Edit HUD layout$() under Controls > LemurSaucePacket.

pages.title: Player (right)
pages.text: Your character as you look right now, then:$(br2)$(#b9a98a)Button - Opens - Key$()$(br)$(bold)Skills$() - Every skill and your level: hover one for what trains it and what it unlocks next, click it for what every level unlocks ($(l:lemursaucepacket:skills)more$(/l)) - $(#e0ac46)/skills$()$(br)$(bold)Backpack$() - The backpack you're wearing - B$(br)$(bold)Team$() - FTB Teams: invite friends, share quest progress - ;$(br)$(bold)Voice$() - Voice chat settings, groups and your microphone - V
$(bold)Guide$() - This wiki, in a browser inside the game; $(bold)Open in browser$() opens it in yours - $(#e0ac46)/guide$() (the book)
